claim: The paper gives conditions on the codimension of the singular set guaranteeing the volume of the singular set is spectrally determined, with sharp counterexamples showing the conditions cannot be relaxed, addressing individual p-spectra of the Hodge Laplacian (not the hyperbolic 2-orbifold cone-order determinacy question).
stance_target: scope of GGKMSS Part 2 relative to the manuscript's hyperbolic cone-orbifold determinacy claim
scope_conditions: general compact Riemannian orbifolds, individual p-spectra
quoted_support: we give conditions on the codimension of the singular set which guarantee that the volume of the singular set is determined, and in many cases we show by providing counterexamples that the conditions are sharp.
